name: Emco Industrial Plastics
old_description: Emco’s skilled staff follows your project through every stage – from inception to creation and shipment. Here at Emco we design, assemble, test, re-test, decorate, package and ship your product. All of our molds are designed internally by our own staff and are 100% made in the USA! Our machines range in size from 30 ton (1 1/2 oz shot) to 550 ton (90 oz shot). Emco’s injection molding division has been manufacturing components since 1988!
about:
Emco Industrial Plastics operates from Cedar Grove, New Jersey. The company’s injection molding division has been manufacturing components since 1988. All molds are designed internally by the company’s own staff and are produced entirely in the United States.

It also offers CNC machining, CNC routing, laser cutting, plastic welding, edge finishing, forming, polishing, drape and oven forming, vacuum forming, sealing and gaskets, and plastic cut-to-size services. The company works with a wide range of engineering plastics including acetal, acrylic, Celtec, Corzan, Delrin, Ertalyte, fiberglass, GPO, HDPE, Hydlar, Kydex, Kynar, Nylatron, nylon, PEEK, and PETG.

Emco serves industries such as aerospace, alternative energy, automotive, building and construction, chemical processing, electrical, fluid handling, food and beverage, heavy equipment, marine, medical, oil and gas, packaging machinery, semiconductor, and water and wastewater treatment. The company also supplies OEM replacement parts.

Emco emphasizes end-to-end project management, following each job from inception through design, assembly, testing, re-testing, decoration, packaging, and shipment. Its molds are designed in-house and made in the USA, and the company highlights its long-standing injection molding experience since 1988.

name: Emergent Solar Energy
old_description: Your business deserves a trusted solar contractor who specializes in getting results for Indiana farms and manufacturers. Get in touch and let’s find a time to visit your site and make a plan together.
about:
Emergent Solar Energy is headquartered in West Lafayette, Indiana, within the Purdue Research Park. The leadership team includes Jeremy Lipinski, Adam Bolen, and Zacaria Martinez.

The firm operates as a full-service solar EPC contractor, delivering turnkey solar photovoltaic and battery energy storage systems under a single contract. Its integrated delivery model covers feasibility analysis, site-specific engineering with performance modeling, equipment procurement, construction management, utility interconnection, and commissioning. The company reports over 10 years of commercial and industrial project experience, with a documented 99.89% operational uptime across active facilities.

Emergent serves manufacturing, agricultural, municipal, institutional, and commercial clients throughout Indiana and neighboring states. Notable projects include a solar installation for Subaru of Indiana Automotive. The company focuses on facilities with complex energy loads, offering solutions that reduce operating costs, manage demand charges, and support sustainability goals.

The company emphasizes disciplined engineering, construction quality, and long-term asset performance. Its differentiation includes PE-engineered designs, component selection driven by warranty strength and supply-chain reliability, and a 25-year production warranty backed by a 5-year workmanship guarantee. The mission centers on fortifying Indiana businesses through energy independence and cost reduction.

name: Emmaus Foods LLC
old_description: We are a Custom Manufacturer of Food Products for the National Chain, Food Service, and Hospitality Segments of the Food Industry. Our Manufacturing Facility and Corporate Office are located in the heart of the Poultry Industry in Albertville, AL! We currently have approximately 500 Team Members to support our Business and are continuously striving to expand our Customer Portfolio through Superior Product Quality and Outstanding Customer Service!
about:
Emmaus Foods LLC operates its manufacturing facility and corporate office in Albertville, Alabama, in the heart of the poultry industry. The privately held limited liability company employs approximately 500 team members. While the food-focused business does not state a founding year, the company's steel fabrication lineage traces to the April 1989 incorporation of Steel and Fabrication Industry, organized by veterans with sixty years of combined experience in steel fabrication, machining, and design.

The company serves two distinct lines: custom food manufacturing for national chain, food service, and hospitality customers, and heavy steel fabrication. The fabrication shop produces custom industrial tanks (including stainless steel), structural steel for commercial and industrial buildings and bridges, stainless steel ducting for semiconductor facilities, stacks for emissions compliance, pressure vessels, cyclones, scrubbers, fan housings, ductwork, hoppers, dampers, slide gates, filter housings, conveyors, and dewatering screen cabinets. It also offers industrial coating services. The operation is supported by a team of certified craftsmen, engineers, and designers.

Customers span the food industry — national chains, food service operators, and hospitality providers — as well as the semiconductor sector (for ducting), commercial and industrial construction (for structural steel and stacks), and a range of other industries that use coated or fabricated steel equipment.

Emmaus Foods emphasizes a "special culture" centered on its team members, aiming to maintain a safe and pleasant workplace. The steel fabrication business was founded to fill a gap left by large manufacturers reducing their in-house fabrication capacity, offering a higher level of excellence in steel fabrication with a commitment to quality and efficiency.

name: Encore Renewable Energy
old_description: We develop, own and operate community-scale solar and energy storage projects. As a certified B-Corp, we leverage our business as a force for good—turning brownfields to brightfields and deploying dual-use solutions like pollinator-friendly ground cover and solar grazing across our portfolio. We’re delivering energy’s second act, or “encore,” by revitalizing communities and creating a cleaner, brighter future for all.
about:
Encore Renewable Energy is based in Burlington, Vermont. Founded as a brownfield redevelopment company, it has evolved into a full-service community-scale renewable energy project developer and operator. The company is a certified B Corporation and a portfolio company of SUSI Partners.

The firm develops, owns, and operates solar and energy storage projects, offering end-to-end services from concept through construction to long-term ownership. It specializes in reclaiming undervalued sites—landfills, brownfields, rooftops, and parking lots—and integrates dual-use approaches such as pollinator-friendly ground cover and solar grazing. Encore ranks as the #1 solar developer in Vermont and among the top 25 nationwide, with projects across the Northeast and a growing portfolio in Illinois.

Its customers include municipalities, businesses, institutions, utilities, non-profits, and landowners. Concrete examples include a 2.25‑megawatt landfill solar array for the Town of Derry, New Hampshire, projected to save $4 million over 25 years, and a multi‑project community solar portfolio under construction in Bureau, Henry, and Macoupin Counties, Illinois, which will maintain agricultural use through sheep grazing.

Encore’s differentiation rests on its B Corp certification, which embeds social and environmental performance into its legal structure, and its core values of integrity, determination, innovation, humility, curiosity, and impact. The company was started to turn brownfields into “brightfields,” leveraging clean energy to revitalize communities and address the climate crisis.

about:
Based in Oostburg, Wisconsin, Endries Solar & Electric was established by Russel Endries, a NABCEP-certified master electrician who installed his first solar system in 2008. The company serves an installation territory that stretches from north of Green Bay through the Fox Valley and Madison area to the Wisconsin-Illinois border.

The firm provides full-service solar electrical products and services, specializing in residential and commercial photovoltaic installations. Its licensed and insured employees handle every step in-house — system design, permitting, installation, commissioning, inspection, and ongoing maintenance — without using subcontractors. To date, the team has installed more than 1,000 PV systems designed by owner Russel Endries.

Endries Solar & Electric works with homeowners and businesses across northern and southeastern Wisconsin. Residential customers receive customized rooftop or ground-mount arrays, while commercial clients range from small businesses to larger facilities seeking to reduce electrical costs and carbon footprints. The company also assists customers with tax credits, incentives, and utility interconnection paperwork.

The company says its differentiators include NABCEP accreditation, membership on Wisconsin's Focus on Energy Trade Ally list, and a commitment to using only its own trained installers. Russel Endries' 20-plus years of electrical experience and the team's combined 100-plus years in the trade are cited as the foundation for code-compliant, production-maximizing installations.

about:
Energy Technologies, Inc. (ETI) operates from Mansfield, Ohio, where it designs and builds rugged power electronics for demanding environments. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

ETI manufactures a broad range of high-reliability power equipment including uninterruptible power supplies (UPS), DC/AC inverters, frequency converters, power conditioners, power distribution units (PDUs), solar power systems, battery backup modules, engine generators, and rugged computers. Products are offered in rackmount, NEMA-rated, portable, and custom configurations. The company emphasizes that its designs originate as rugged rather than being adapted from commercial off-the-shelf units, and it validates hardware against military standards such as MIL-STD-167-1 and MIL-STD-810.

The company serves defense, industrial, telecommunications, and medical sectors. Its product families — Rugged Power™, Military Power®, Tactical Power®, Airborne Power®, Industrial Power Source®, and Extreme Power Source™ — address applications from fixed-site data centers to mobile tactical shelters, microgrids, and airborne platforms. Customers include military programs, telecom infrastructure operators, and industrial facilities requiring hardened power conditioning.

ETI states its differentiation lies in ground-up rugged design, full Mil-Spec compliance across product lines, and integrated solutions such as combined UPS/PDU chassis that reduce rack space and cabling. The firm also develops deployable tactical power plants, solar and wind generation kits, and environmental control units for field use.

old_description: ETP, Engineered Textile Products, Inc., is a leader in the custom fabrication of a large variety of environmental and industrial fabric products for the water, agriculture, and manufacturing industries. We distribute our products nationwide and export many of them throughout the world.
about:
Engineered Textile Products (ETP) is a family-owned textile fabrication company based in Mobile, Alabama. Founded in 1877, the business has been passed through five generations of the same family, growing from a local operation into a supplier of custom fabric solutions for clients across the United States and overseas.

The company specializes in custom-designed textile products for environmental containment, industrial protection, and recreational shading. Its product lines include ETP Environmental for site-specific liners and curtains, ETP Industrial for tarps and asset covers, ETP Artcraft Awnings for commercial and residential shade structures, ETP Sports for track-and-field surfaces and gym equipment, and ETP Racemarks for course marking and branding at regattas and triathlons. All items are fabricated to order using premium materials selected for durability in harsh conditions.

ETP serves the water management, agriculture, and manufacturing sectors, along with government agencies such as NASA, educational institutions, and event organizers worldwide. Past projects range from containment systems at the Port of Mobile to shade structures for high school athletic facilities and branding for international triathlon competitions.

The company attributes its longevity to a proactive approach: collaborating closely with customers to engineer precision-fit solutions that address specific environmental challenges, backed by 149 years of accumulated expertise.
